title: Interactive Volumetric Cloud
desc: Orbit the canonical 3D Float32 cloud, pan, zoom and relight it. Camera changes reuse the optical cache; drag previews refine on release.
kind: JS CPU · no build or assets

title: Airborne smoke
desc: A/B playback of the V1 and V2 cinematic smoke study. Scrub the timeline, step through frames and compare the original renders.

title: Terrain Fog
desc: Explore ground-hugging fog in a forest valley. Change viewpoint, sunlight and coverage; terrain and tree depth occlude the volume.
kind: JS CPU · no build or assets

title: Smoke volume inspector
desc: Inspect the saved Float32 fields from different camera angles and lighting. Renders on demand in a CPU worker.
status: Node optical render tested; browser pending

title: Fidelity Lab / reference settings
desc: Compare generator and optical settings for cloud and fog in the original reference tool. Archived fluid snapshots remain local-only.

title: Scene depth / compositing
desc: Technical comparison of fog compositing with and without opaque-scene depth.

title: Animated cloud
desc: Stream two adjacent VPA1 Float32 keyframes and interpolate a moving 3D cloud in the experimental WebGPU renderer.

title: WebGPU Fidelity cloud / renderer
desc: Experimental GPU optical-depth cache and Float32 cloud rendering. Separate from the featured CPU viewer.

title: Direct WebGPU volume
desc: Explore the GPU solver and Direct, Temporal and Fidelity rendering paths. Hybrid requires a locally built Rust WASM module.

title: Effects Studio
desc: Edit presets and choose CPU, GPU or Hybrid. Fluid presets need the matching runtime; use the local repository.

title: Rust CPU Canvas
desc: Use the actual Rust WASM solver and CPU renderer. Build the WASM binary before running.

title: Web SDK integration
desc: Host application example using the web runtime and engine rendering adapter.
